features.name: multiple_counter_comments
features.definition: Does the discussion contain more than one counter-argument comment?
features.spec: Parse OC_comments as a JSON list. Return 1 if len(list) >= 2, 0 if len(list) == 1 (an empty list gives 0). Return null if missing or malformed. Counts list entries, not verified distinct commenters or distinct arguments.

h0: multiple_counter_comments has no association with view change (delta).
h1: Discussions with multiple_counter_comments = 1 have a higher likelihood of view change than those with a single comment.
note: "Distinct" is operationalized as separate list entries; the list may include multiple comments by the same commenter and no per-comment authorship is supplied. Order and timing are unknown. The comment list may contain outcome announcements or later replies; this is a raw count and not filtered for them. Association only, not causal.
